::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 18th 1874  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: Bryce 156 (microfilm) ff19-20
:::

My dear [Miss Freeman](people/person_524.qmd)
Let me hint at the wonderful adventures of the Scottish regalia in Cromwell’s time. Meeting with them in Miss Macarthurs [history](other_books/otherbook_846.qmd)set me upon the question.[^1] Also Colonel Blood and the English. I think too the iron crown of Lombardy might come in and the adventures of the Scottish royal stone would be admissible. I tell you all this to be secure of someone making a full answer

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Freeman was taking part in the [Spider Society](organizations/other_116.qmd) essay competitions in the *MP*. 'What curious adventures have the Regalia of different countries undergone?' was one of the Spider questions for May 1874.  'Pisa''s 'Curious Adventures of the Regalia of Different Countries',  appeared in *MP* (July 1874), 3-9.
